title: Form 24D Application Procedure and Checklist for ASU Manufacturing License
content: To manufacture Ayurveda, Siddha, or Unani (ASU) drugs for commercial sale in India, an applicant must submit Form 24D (statutory application form for grant or renewal of a licence) to the State Licensing Authority. Form 24D is separate from product category classifications such as Patent or Proprietary Ayurvedic Medicine. Key statutory requirements include competent technical personnel supervision by qualified personnel (holding a recognized degree or diploma in Ayurvedic Medicine, Siddha, Unani, or B.Pharm Ayurveda) and full compliance with Schedule T Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) covering premises layout, equipment, sanitation, raw material storage, and quality control testing.
